formulas.ordinary_detection_score: Awareness + relevant_sensory_mastery + information_bonus + preparation + team_sensor_bonus + visibility_modifier - fatigue_penalty - injury_penalty
formulas.concealment_score: Stealth + concealment_equipment + terrain_concealment + technique_concealment + movement_discipline - exposure_penalty - noise_penalty

rules: A channel cannot report information it cannot physically sense.
Line of sight, occlusion, medium, blind spots, and registered barriers are evaluated before score comparison.
Near-360-degree awareness is not literal omniscience and retains registered blind spots.
Information already known can reduce reaction delay but cannot create current target location without a current valid channel.
